tasks.subject: Task 1: Graph Models — NodeState + Edge union + GraphState
tasks.description:
Implement the core graph data models in `graph.py`: NodeState (representing a node in the processing graph with position, parameters, resources, and display state), ColumnRefEdge and PositionalEdge (two edge variants distinguished by a `type` discriminator field), the Edge discriminated union type, and GraphState (container for nodes and edges). Tests cover construction, defaults, validation errors on missing required fields, discriminated union dispatch for both edge types, rejection of unknown type values, and JSON round-trip serialization for all models including mixed-edge GraphState.

```json:metadata
{
  "files": [
    "backend/src/bioimageflow_server/models/graph.py",
    "backend/tests/test_models/test_graph.py"
  ],
  "verifyCommand": "cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_models/test_graph.py -v",
  "acceptanceCriteria": [
    "NodeState model accepts all required and optional fields with correct defaults",
    "ColumnRefEdge and PositionalEdge have correct Literal type discriminators",
    "Edge discriminated union dispatches to correct subtype from dict input",
    "Edge union rejects unknown type values with ValidationError",
    "GraphState holds mixed edge types and survives JSON round-trip",
    "All 12 tests in test_graph.py pass"
  ],
  "requiresUserVerification": false
}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Validation Models — NodeStatus + GraphValidationError + ValidationResult
tasks.description:
Implement validation-related models in `validation.py`: NodeStatus (server-computed per-node status with a 6-value Literal status field, cached flag, and optional error/traceback), GraphValidationError (a single validation issue with an 8-value Literal type, detail message, and optional node/edge/field references), and ValidationResult (the PUT /graph response containing validity flag, node_statuses dict, and errors list). Tests verify defaults, acceptance and rejection of Literal values, nested model construction, and JSON round-trip serialization.

```json:metadata
{
  "files": [
    "backend/src/bioimageflow_server/models/validation.py",
    "backend/tests/test_models/test_validation.py"
  ],
  "verifyCommand": "cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_models/test_validation.py -v",
  "acceptanceCriteria": [
    "NodeStatus defaults error and traceback to None",
    "NodeStatus accepts all 6 valid status strings and rejects invalid ones",
    "GraphValidationError accepts all 8 valid type strings and rejects invalid ones",
    "ValidationResult defaults to empty node_statuses and errors",
    "ValidationResult JSON round-trip preserves nested NodeStatus and error objects",
    "All 11 tests in test_validation.py pass"
  ],
  "requiresUserVerification": false
}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Execution Models — ExecutionRequest + ProgressInfo + ExecutionResult + ExecutionStatus
tasks.description:
Implement execution-related models in `execution.py`: ExecutionRequest (POST /execution/run body with graph dict and optional node list), ProgressInfo (current node progress with row/total_rows), ExecutionResult (success flag with optional errors and node_statuses importing NodeStatus from validation), and ExecutionStatus (GET /execution/status response with running/idle state and optional last_result and progress). Tests cover full and selective execution requests, default values, invalid state rejection, and JSON round-trip with nested ExecutionResult and ProgressInfo.

```json:metadata
{
  "files": [
    "backend/src/bioimageflow_server/models/execution.py",
    "backend/tests/test_models/test_execution.py"
  ],
  "verifyCommand": "cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_models/test_execution.py -v",
  "acceptanceCriteria": [
    "ExecutionRequest accepts graph dict and optional nodes list",
    "ProgressInfo requires node_id, row, and total_rows",
    "ExecutionResult defaults errors to empty list and node_statuses to empty dict",
    "ExecutionStatus accepts only 'running' and 'idle' state values",
    "ExecutionStatus JSON round-trip preserves nested ExecutionResult and ProgressInfo",
    "All 8 tests in test_execution.py pass"
  ],
  "requiresUserVerification": false
}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Workflow + Settings Models
tasks.description:
Implement workflow models in `workflow.py` (WorkflowCreate, WorkflowInfo, WorkflowUpdate with Literal action field, WorkflowFile with workflow and gui dicts) and settings models in `settings.py` (OMEROInstance with default port 4064, Settings with 12 fields including Literal-validated deployment_mode and execution_engine, flexible update_mode accepting both Literal values and arbitrary version strings, and various optional fields with defaults). Tests cover minimal and full construction, Literal validation and rejection, OMERO instance defaults, Settings JSON round-trip, and update_mode flexibility.

```json:metadata
{
  "files": [
    "backend/src/bioimageflow_server/models/workflow.py",
    "backend/src/bioimageflow_server/models/settings.py",
    "backend/tests/test_models/test_workflow.py",
    "backend/tests/test_models/test_settings.py"
  ],
  "verifyCommand": "cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_models/test_workflow.py tests/test_models/test_settings.py -v",
  "acceptanceCriteria": [
    "WorkflowCreate requires only name, other fields optional",
    "WorkflowUpdate accepts 'update' and 'duplicate' actions, rejects invalid ones",
    "WorkflowFile round-trips workflow and gui dicts",
    "OMEROInstance defaults port to 4064 and name to None",
    "Settings rejects invalid deployment_mode and execution_engine values",
    "Settings update_mode accepts both Literal values and arbitrary version strings",
    "All 12 tests across test_workflow.py and test_settings.py pass"
  ],
  "requiresUserVerification": false
}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Re-exports + Verification
tasks.description:
Populate `models/__init__.py` with re-exports of all 18 model classes from graph, validation, execution, workflow, settings, and errors submodules, and define an alphabetically-sorted `__all__` list. Create an import test verifying all models are importable from `bioimageflow_server.models` in a single import statement and that class names match expected values. Run the full test suite across all test_models/ to confirm everything passes end-to-end.

